name: orders-cancel
description: Add order cancellation to the existing orders API without changing existing behaviour.

change.summary: DELETE /v1/orders/:id cancels a pending order and returns 204. An unknown id returns 404. An order that has already shipped cannot be cancelled and returns 409.

acceptance: DELETE on a pending order returns 204 and a later GET returns 404
DELETE on an unknown order returns 404 problem+json
DELETE on a shipped order returns 409 problem+json
every existing orders test still passes
